Software Engineer – University Hire

Wondering what’s within Beckman Coulter Diagnostics? Take a closer look.

At first glance, you’ll see that for more than 80 years we’ve been dedicated to advancing and optimizing the laboratory to move science and healthcare forward. Join a team where you can be heard, be supported, and always be yourself. We’re building a culture that celebrates backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives of all our associates. Look again and you’ll see we are invested in you, providing the opportunity to build a meaningful career, be creative, and try new things with the support you need to be successful.

Beckman Coulter Diagnostics is proud to work alongside a community of six fellow Diagnostics Companies at Danaher. Together, we’re working at the pace of change to improve patient lives with diagnostic tools that address the world’s biggest health challenges. At Beckman Coulter, our vision is to relentlessly reimagine healthcare, one diagnosis at a time. If you thrive in a collaborative environment and want to work to build a world-class engineering organization—read on.

About The Role

Beckman Coulter's IT Integration Architecture team is transforming how enterprise systems connect through technology modernization and AI enablement, by moving to Boomi's cloud-native integration platform to power the next generation technology landscape. This internship offers hands-on exposure to a live, large-scale integration migration spanning numerous integration processes and multiple trading partner connections. You'll join the IT Integration Team, reporting to the manager responsible for integrations at Beckman IT, and work alongside senior integration architects and developers to build, test, and document Boomi processes supporting real-time business systems.

In this role, you will have the following opportunities, but are not limited to:



-  Participating in an Agile Scrum team, working as a team member and independently
-  B2B and Cloud Applications Integration - Build Workflows, Data Integration and API/web service concepts -Troubleshoot issues and fix software bugs
-  Collaborate on integration requirements, design options, build and root cause of failures with partners and teammates
-  Give/Receive feedback in peer code inspections to ensure quality of the integrations and produce documentation required for integration design, mapping and build.

The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include



-  Bachelor’s degree program such as Computer Science, Software Engineering, Biomedical Engineering with computational focus, or other relevant engineering degrees.
-  Familiarity with Java, JavaScript, Groovy, or similar languages, along with an understanding of API/web service concepts and comfort reading or building structured data formats like XML and/or JSON
-  Demonstrated interest in integration or automation via coursework, personal projects, or hands-on work connecting applications, building workflows, or mapping data.
-  Ability to write clear, organized technical documentation, mapping logic, or step-by-step guides and communicate effectively with a team.
-  Comfortable reviewing logs or output to trace errors, isolate root causes, and troubleshoot systematically

It Would Be a Plus If You Also Have



-  API Testing Tools: Practical experience using Postman (or equivalent tools such as SOAP UI) to interact with, inspect, and debug live web endpoints.
-  B2B/EDI knowledge is a plus but not required — familiarity with electronic data interchange concepts or trading partner integration patterns.
-  Familiarity working with a version control system, like SVN and GIT
-  Foundational understanding of Scrum/Agile frameworks.

The hourly rate for this role is $30 per hour. This is the rate that we in good faith believe is the rate of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. This rate may be modified in the future.

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

For more information, visit www.danaher.com.
